tokens.name: night-900
tokens.usage: App background and the sky behind every screen. The deepest ground.

tokens.name: night-800
tokens.usage: Map ground (land, empty blocks) and the chat background.

tokens.name: night-700
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: inputs, the inside of glass cards once composited, list rows.

tokens.name: night-600
tokens.usage: Pressed/hover fills on night-700 and dividers inside glass cards.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of every GlassCard, GlassToast and the dock. Always over night-800 or darker, never over the bright city art.

tokens.name: glass-line
tokens.usage: 1px border of glass surfaces and the input outline at rest.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on night-900, night-800, night-700 and glass-fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (mood lines, dialog bodies) on night-700, glass-fill and darker. 8:1 on night-700.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions only: name · distance under bubbles, counters, timestamps. 4.7:1 on night-700; never smaller than caption.

tokens.name: aurora-violet
tokens.usage: Bright end of the signature gradient: headline keyword, glowing borders, halos, the focus ring. Never a fill under white text (3.9:1).

tokens.name: aurora-blue
tokens.usage: Other end of the signature gradient, and the radar ripple of the viewer's own position. Never a fill under white text (2:1).

tokens.name: deep-violet
tokens.usage: Start of the button gradient. White text on it is 5.8:1.

tokens.name: deep-blue
tokens.usage: End of the button gradient and the viewer's own chat bubble. White text on it is 5.5:1.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text and icons on deep-violet, deep-blue and the button gradient between them.

tokens.name: knock-pink
tokens.usage: Everything about knocking: the pending pulse, the dotted arc to the target, the 300-second bar.

tokens.name: city-amber
tokens.usage: Only the 同意 action, the one warm word in a dialog. Never on the map: warm road colours clash with the navy-violet ground (tested orange and dark gold on device, both rejected).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Block and report: icon, label, and the 1px border of the danger button. Text 5.7:1 on night-700.

tokens.name: map-road-major
tokens.usage: Map: motorways, trunk and primary roads; their glow is the same colour at 12% opacity, blurred. Muted teal sits inside the cool night palette.

tokens.name: map-road-mid
tokens.usage: Map: secondary roads; glow 10%.

tokens.name: map-road-minor
tokens.usage: Map: minor streets and alleys; glow 8%.

tokens.name: map-road-path
tokens.usage: Map: footpaths and service roads, no glow.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Map: rivers and lakes, outlined with deep-blue.

tokens.name: map-building-low
tokens.usage: Map: 3D buildings at ground height; blends to map-building-high by 150 m. Extrusion opacity 0.72.

tokens.name: map-building-high
tokens.usage: Map: the tallest buildings, the only touch of violet on the map.

tokens.name: mood-joy
tokens.usage: Mood text containing 😊 開心 笑. Bubble border, halo, pin and ripple only; text stays ink.

tokens.name: mood-sad
tokens.usage: Mood text containing 😢 難過 哭.

tokens.name: mood-angry
tokens.usage: Mood text containing 😡 生氣 怒. Kept apart from danger (#ff6b7a) by hue and lightness.

tokens.name: mood-calm
tokens.usage: Mood text containing 🌿 平靜 發呆.

tokens.name: mood-passion
tokens.usage: Mood text containing 🔥 熱情.

tokens.name: mood-love
tokens.usage: Mood text containing 💖 愛 心.

tokens.name: mood-default
tokens.usage: Any mood that matches none of the keywords. Replaces the old tealAccent default.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: Shadow (歷史殘影) bubbles: border and icon. The bubble itself fades with age; this colour does not change.

families.sans: "Noto Sans TC", "PingFang TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding headlines only. The first two characters carry the bright gradient.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 安卓Pixel 9 正在敲門，想與你產生交集。
styles.usage: Dialog bodies, chat messages, form text.

styles.name: mood
styles.usage: The one line of mood text inside a MoodBubble.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Name · distance under bubbles, counters, hints. The smallest text in the app.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Countdowns (knock 300 秒, chat 10 分鐘). Always tabular.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a bubble and its caption; between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of bubbles and toasts.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter and card inner padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card inner padding when the card holds a form; gap between card sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a headline block and the card below it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs inside cards, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: MoodBubble body and chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: GlassCard, the dock, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: GradientButton, GlassToast, CountdownPill, avatars.

tokens.name: glow-violet
tokens.usage: Halo of glass cards and the primary button.

tokens.name: glow-pink
tokens.usage: A bubble while a knock is pending.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Under any card that floats over the map.

tokens.name: resting
tokens.usage: A 休息中 bubble (locked or backgrounded, still knockable).

tokens.name: shadow-start
tokens.usage: A 歷史殘影 the moment it appears; it fades linearly to shadow-end over its retention time.

tokens.name: shadow-end
tokens.usage: A 歷史殘影 just before it disappears.
